Transformer supply outlook: capacity, lead times and electrical steel

This report reviews the supply of large power and distribution transformers in North America. Average lead times for large power transformers reached 120 to 210 weeks in 2026, compared with about 50 weeks in 2021.

Domestic manufacturing capacity for large power transformers has expanded by roughly one fifth since 2023, but demand from grid expansion and data-centre connections continues to exceed supply.

Grain-oriented electrical steel remains the constraining input: only a handful of mills produce it, and allocations for 2027 are largely committed.

Member manufacturers report that new factories take three to four years to commission, so relief from capacity additions is not expected before 2029.
